proposals.evidence: Turner asmad explicitly groups the western ame/āmhī, central ham, northwestern as/assī and Khowar ispā pronouns, deriving their modern paradigms from Middle Indo-Aryan nominative, oblique and instrumental forms. The selected survey pronouns fit these regional families, including contracted spā and western am(u) variants. Inclusive/exclusive labels are retained as elicited, not projected onto the ancestor.
